content: Supplicant Welcome to Earth 2.0 Stand Alone .  In the far future, earth has populated a new galaxy terraforming new worlds  and spreading amongst the stars, from that new far galaxy a prince of worlds comes home to earth .  He quickly finds himself the victim of a  trap,   Upon  waking he finds himself a slave in the underground games on Mars. Marius must survive and regain his freedom if is he to gain vengeance over those who mean to take  overrule  of the planet that is rightfully his.    Idea Point This is an idea point, things I need to remember about the possible plot.  Prince Andr onimus Marius Corbin Prince of the planet Neriosis Marius grew up spoiled the son of a King and Heir to a planet , trained as a commander, warrior and diplomat he is close to taking the reigns of power, but those aligned against his father have planned a trap for the prince, can he survive NOTES: These are notes on the book that I can add later as I think of things  He was  trained ,  but is spoiled He discovers a new life as a slave where he works the mines and then because of his rallying of the other slaves in a failed revolt, he is sold to the blood sports arena, an underground criminal games where slaves go to die He succeeds and becomes infamous He befriends the slave owner, who once was a slave himself and earns his  freedom ,  finding a new purpose in rallying the other slaves to overcome the games, the crooked politicians who allow it to run and the criminal bosses.
